levels.surface: الحسن بن محمد بن عبد الله بن عيسى

notes: the compiler's shaykh «أبي» is his father, named only by relation; «- بزرج -» is an editor's gloss, left out; «يعني موسى بن جعفر» is a gloss, so the Imam is written as he stands
Mansur speaks to Uthman («قال لي منصور»), and the Imam speaks in Mansur's account («فقال لي: يا منصور»), so the Imam is last (ruling 5)
